title: runtime package doors: the multi-replica refusal tells the operator to "run it on a single replica or through the CLI", both of which are refused the same way while replicas are declared
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Filing gate: ④ sibling finding of #32176 (PR #32262), reported by its card thread. #32176 fixed the same flaw in the install-local doors' message (`cloud-connection`); this is the runtime package doors' copy, outside that card's file surface. Code read on `origin/main`; not live-measured.
Business reason: an operator rolling a package change on a multi-replica deployment follows the refusal's remedy, is refused again, and has no working recipe.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat that claims it. The fix lands in `packages/runtime/src/multi-replica-package-refusal.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `multiReplicaPackageChangeMessage` (only #32176, the install-local sibling).
reach: every runtime package-change door that calls `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange` (enable/disable and the paired-customization ensure).

## What happens

`multiReplicaPackageChangeMessage` (`packages/runtime/src/multi-replica-package-refusal.ts` L63) ends its remedy with: "Make the change in a maintenance window instead: run it on a single replica or through the CLI, then restart every replica."

- "On a single replica": while `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS > 1` or `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true` stands, any one replica still reads the declaration and refuses the same way.
- "Through the CLI": the CLI's package commands post to the same doors (the card thread for #32176 measured this for `os package install`), so they are refused too.

## Expected

The message names steps that work, as PR #32262 does for install-local: scale to one replica restarted with `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1` and `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE` unset, make the change, restore the count and the declaration, restart every replica, plus the condition the change needs to reach the others (here: where the registry and the enable/disable choice are read at boot). The refusal's status, code and trigger do not change. Consider sharing one sentence builder with `multiReplicaInstallLocalRefusalMessage` once #32262 lands.

Clause-②: no (remedy text only).
